skill.name: edit-article
skill.description: Restructure article sections, improve clarity and flow, confirm the outline, and rewrite paragraphs within a 240-character limit.
skill.summary: Reorder article sections and tighten each paragraph through a user-confirmed editing workflow.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in the single prompt-only file. Semantic review found article-editing instructions only, with no prompt injection, data exfiltration, executable code, or external access.

content.value_statement: Article drafts often bury key ideas or present them before essential context. This skill reorganizes sections, confirms the plan, and rewrites concise paragraphs for clearer reading.
actual_capabilities: Divides an article into sections based on its headings.
Maps main points and information dependencies to improve section order.
Requests user confirmation before rewriting the proposed sections.
Rewrites each section for clarity, coherence, and flow.
limitations: Section planning depends on clear headings or enough draft structure to infer them.
The skill does not verify facts, citations, links, or source accuracy.
The 240-character paragraph limit can remove useful detail from technical or nuanced material.
The workflow requires user confirmation before section rewrites continue.

use_cases.title: Restructure a Blog Draft
use_cases.description: Restructure a draft so each section introduces ideas after the context they require.

use_cases.title: Improve a Technical Tutorial
use_cases.description: Improve the sequence and clarity of a tutorial while keeping paragraphs concise.

use_cases.title: Review an Article Outline
use_cases.description: Review an article outline with the writer before applying section-by-section revisions.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify a Short Draft
prompt_templates.prompt:
Edit the article below for clarity and flow. First, propose sections from its headings and ask me to confirm them. Then rewrite each confirmed section. Keep every paragraph within 240 characters.

[Paste article]
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner wants a guided edit of a simple article.

prompt_templates.title: Reorder a Tutorial
prompt_templates.prompt:
Review this tutorial and identify dependencies between its ideas. Propose a section order that introduces required context first. Wait for my confirmation before rewriting. Keep paragraphs within 240 characters.

[Paste tutorial]
prompt_templates.scenario: A technical author needs a clearer teaching sequence.

prompt_templates.title: Preserve Audience and Tone
prompt_templates.prompt:
Restructure this article for [target audience]. Preserve its [tone] while improving clarity, coherence, and flow. Explain the proposed section order briefly. Ask for confirmation, then rewrite one section at a time. Keep paragraphs within 240 characters.

[Paste article]
prompt_templates.scenario: An editor needs structural changes without losing the intended voice.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Complex Argument
prompt_templates.prompt:
Map the claims, evidence, definitions, and dependencies in this draft. Identify sections that rely on unexplained earlier concepts. Propose a corrected outline with one purpose statement per section. After confirmation, rewrite each section and flag details lost because of the 240-character paragraph limit.

[Paste draft]
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced writer needs a dependency-aware review of a detailed argument.

output_examples.input: Draft headings: Installation, Prerequisites, Overview. Improve the structure.
output: Overview defines the goal. Prerequisites supplies required context. Installation then presents the steps.
Please confirm this section order before I rewrite the draft.

output_examples.input: Original: Our review process is something that happens every week, and it helps the team make decisions about work that should happen next.
output_examples.output: We review progress weekly, then decide which work should come next.

best_practices: Provide the complete draft with meaningful headings before requesting edits.
State the intended audience, tone, and facts that must remain unchanged.
Review and confirm the proposed section order before requesting section rewrites.
anti_patterns: Do not omit headings when the draft needs substantial structural changes.
Do not expect the skill to verify unsupported claims or citation accuracy.
Do not accept concise rewrites that remove required context or qualifications.

faq.question: What does this skill change?
faq.answer: It reorganizes sections and rewrites their paragraphs for clarity, coherence, and flow.

faq.question: Does it rewrite the article immediately?
faq.answer: No. It first proposes sections and asks you to confirm them.

faq.question: How does it choose the section order?
faq.answer: It considers which ideas depend on earlier context and orders sections around those dependencies.

faq.question: Is there a paragraph length limit?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill directs each rewritten paragraph to stay within 240 characters.

faq.question: Does it fact-check the draft?
faq.answer: No. Verify claims, citations, links, and source accuracy separately.

faq.question: Can it preserve my writing voice?
faq.answer: The instructions do not guarantee voice preservation. State your desired tone and review each rewrite.
